youtube.title: Replaced by AI After 20 Years. This Is What He Did Next.
youtube.description:
After twenty years at the same desk, one email replaced him with AI.
The job market was full of people just like him. The bills never paused. Months passed with no answers.
Until one night, his little girl asked one question, and he remembered who he was fighting for.

Bad days end. No storm lasts forever. Keep going.

Hand-drawn stories that keep you going. ✏️
New stories every week on PencilStories.
